items.rss_summary:
Costa Rica denied entry ⁠to the United Nations special rapporteur on ⁠the Israeli-occupied Palestinian territories, drawing criticism from UN human rights chief Volker Turk on Friday.
Costa Rica’s move put the small Central American country’s increasingly close alignment with Washington and Israel on security and foreign policy into the spotlight.
Turk said he was “deeply concerned” by Costa Rica’s ‌decision to bar Francesca Albanese from entering the country and urged authorities to reconsider.
